title: Ordinary pullback preserves the essential image of open extension
statement: Let a:U′→U, j′:U′→X′, j:U→X and g:X′→X be a cartesian square of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-fibre-product], with j and j′ open immersions [def-weil-open-immersion]. Let RX, RU, RX′, RU′ be arbitrary commutative ring sheaves on their small pro-etale sites, with specified isomorphisms cj:j inverse(RX)≅RU, cg:g inverse(RX)≅RX′ and cj′:j′ inverse(RX′)≅RU′. Use the actual ordinary module pullbacks [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations] and their open-extension left adjoints [def-weil-pbc-projection-compactification]. For every ordinary RU-module sheaf M, g*(j! M) lies in the essential image of j′!: there exists an RU′-module N and an isomorphism j′! N≅g*(j! M). No derived category, completed coefficient ring, specified exchange map or comparison of composite module pullbacks occurs in this assertion.

proof.text: Flip the given IsPullback square and use its canonical isoPullback and projection equations to make a ChosenCartesianSquare with vertical arrows g and a and horizontal opens j and j prime. Complete the three coefficient isomorphisms by an isomorphism ca along a: equality of the two composite scheme morphisms transports the composite coefficient isomorphism through g and j prime; cancel the inverse-image compositor along a and j and the inverse image of cj. The private completeCoefficientIso lemma proves this coefficient-completion argument by equality induction and cancellation of isomorphisms. This gives a coherent StrictTowerRingedSquare without imposing any additional hypothesis on the given coefficients.

Apply RingedRestrictionExchange.ordinary_open_isIso to the resulting ringed square. Its ordinary comparison is an isomorphism from g-direct-image followed by j-pullback to j-prime-pullback followed by a-direct-image. This existing arbitrary-coefficient theorem already performs the sectionwise open localization calculation.

Compose the extension/restriction adjunction at j with the pullback/direct-image adjunction at g. Compose the pullback/direct-image adjunction at a with the extension/restriction adjunction at j prime. Transport the first composite adjunction across the right-adjoint isomorphism and apply leftAdjointUniq. Its inverse component at M identifies j-prime-extension of a-pullback of M with g-pullback of j-extension of M, furnishing the essential-image witness. Equality induction and the adjunction laws require neither nonempty opens nor nonzero coefficients.

lean.statement:
theorem proEtaleRingPullback_openSupport {U' U X' X : Scheme.{u}}
    (a : U' ⟶ U) (j' : U' ⟶ X') (j : U ⟶ X) (g : X' ⟶ X)
    [IsOpenImmersion j] [IsOpenImmersion j'] (sq : IsPullback a j' j g)
    (RX : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (RU : Sheaf (ProEt.topology U) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (RX' : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X') CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (RU' : Sheaf (ProEt.topology U') CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (cj : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage j CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj RX ≅ RU)
    (cg : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage g CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj RX ≅ RX')
    (cj' : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage j' CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj RX' ≅ RU')
    (M : proEtaleRingModules U RU) :
    (proEtaleRingOpenExtension j' RX' RU' cj').essImage
      ((proEtaleRingModulePullback g RX RX' cg).obj
        ((proEtaleRingOpenExtension j RX RU cj).obj M))
